title: The Vivid memory of the journey
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：vivid　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 vivid 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 the keeper wrote of ① a vivid memory of the journey in the register, and everybody in the zoo said at once that it was ② more vivid than the one named there the year before. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the keeper, who never explained anything, had done it in the rain and gone home; it was the vivid ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most vivid memory of the journey anybody in the zoo had ever seen, or so the register for March 1962 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too vivid to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the child who had come to help; the vivid ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the fence at the far shed, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a vivid green of the field, and said that no child in his right mind would call it ⑥ as vivid as the green of the field they had once had in the old zoo. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was vivid or not, and he said so.

By 1975 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the register. What the line asked for was ⑦ something vivid, and nothing besides. The child from the next zoo called the whole plan ⑧ quite vivid; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the register kept the names of the vivid ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1978, without complaint, she wrote of another vivid memory of the journey in the same register, and the work, which took two seasons, seemed ⑨ more vivid than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most vivid green of the field in the whole zoo, she said in 1980, was the one she could never quite name; the vivid ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 生动（前置定语 a vivid memory of the journey：1968 年饲养员在饲养台账里记下的那件生动的回忆）
B. adj. 生动／鲜艳（比较级 more vivid than：文中两处，一处比对那次旅行生动的回忆，一处比预想）
C. adj. 生动／鲜艳（最高级 the most vivid：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 生动（表语 too vivid to do：母亲觉得它太生动，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 鲜艳（前置定语 a vivid green of the field：叔叔把整件事称作一桩鲜艳的绿）
F. adj. 鲜艳（同级比较 as vivid as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩田野鲜亮的绿相比）
G. adj. 鲜艳（后置定语 something vivid：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 鲜艳（受程度副词修饰 quite vivid：那位孩子的评价）

items.q: a vivid memory of the journey
the most vivid memory of the journey anybody
a vivid green of the field
The most vivid green of the field in

answers.why: vivid 意为“生动”，1968 年饲养员在饲养台账里记下的是“一件生动的回忆”，此处作前置定语 a vivid memory of the journey。
vivid 意为“生动”，此处用比较级 more vivid than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
vivid 意为“生动”，饲养台账上 三月 那行字说它是兽舍里最生动的一件，故用最高级 the most vivid memory of the journey。
vivid 意为“生动”，母亲认为这件东西“太生动了，谁也用不上”，too vivid to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
vivid 意为“鲜艳”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩鲜艳的绿”，此处作前置定语 a vivid green of the field。
vivid 意为“鲜艳”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩田野鲜亮的绿一样鲜艳”，同级比较用 as vivid as。
vivid 意为“鲜艳”，饲养台账上那半行字要的是“鲜艳的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something vivid。
vivid 意为“鲜艳”，邻兽舍来的那位孩子认为这套计划“相当鲜艳”，quite 修饰原级 vivid。
vivid 意为“鲜艳”，1978 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要鲜艳”，故用比较级 more vivid than。
vivid 意为“鲜艳”，母亲 1980 年说的是“整个兽舍里最鲜艳的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most vivid green of the field。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1968 年，饲养员在饲养台账里记下了一件生动的回忆。（a vivid memory of the journey）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更生动。（more vivid than …）
母亲觉得它太生动，谁也用不上。（too vivid to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩鲜艳的绿。（a vivid green of the field）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩田野鲜亮的绿一样鲜艳。（as vivid as …）
到了 1975 年，饲养台账上只剩半行字：要的是一件鲜艳的东西。（something vivid）
answers: In 1968 the keeper wrote of a vivid memory of the journey in the register.
Everybody said it was more vivid than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too vivid to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a vivid green of the field.
He said nobody would call it as vivid as the green of the field they had once had.
By 1975 the register asked for nothing but something vivid.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 vivid 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1968 the keeper wrote of a vivid memory of the journey in the register, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most vivid memory of the journey in the zoo, or so the register says.
My mother thought it too vivid to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a vivid green of the field, and nobody argued with him.
The child from the next zoo called the plan quite vivid, and everybody laughed.
The vivid ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
